K-45 (the user's rule, 2026-09-27): stopping a question's timer is nobody's to do but the user at the card — never an agent's. A night relay stood still for hours on a question nobody was there to answer; an op that let any agent freeze another's clock is exactly that failure on demand. The person's own Stop timer works under every filter, off included (decided 2026-09-27).

K-45 (the user's rule, 2026-09-27): the half-made choice a person leaves on a question card while its clock runs. It is what their own hand did at the card, kept so the timer sends it instead of overwriting it; an agent answers a question outright with console.answer and has no half-made choice to leave.

X-100 - a route credential is typed into the host password box and stored in the OS keychain. The bridge is a plaintext request/response FILE channel, so an op that carried the value would defeat the keychain it is on its way to - the same deliberate exception the secret vault has (`_REF/bridge.md`). Whether a credential EXISTS is public and providers.list returns it.
